newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- Eau Claire, Wis..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Eau Claire, Wis..

text.p: City of Eau Claire, Eau Claire and Chippewa Counties,
Waterworks System Mortgage Revenue Bonds, Series 1997B

Until August 12, 1997, at 10:00 A.M., Central Time, sealed bids only will be received at the offices of Hutchinson, Shockey, Erley &Co., 200 N. Jefferson Street, Suite 100, Milwaukee, WI53202, for the above issue to be dated August 1, 1997, and to mature October 1,

The Bonds do not constitute an indebtedness of the City within the meaning of any constitutional or statutory debt limitation or provision and are not secured by and do not give rise to a charge against the general credit or taxing powers of the City. The Bonds are limited obligations of the City of Eau Claire payable only out of Pledged Revenues. The Bonds are being issued for public purposes. The Depository Trust Company book-entry-only system will be utilized in connection with the issuance of the Bonds.

Chapman &Cutler, Chicago, Illinois. Additional information and a copy of the Near Final Official Statement and Notice of Bond Sale, which set forth additional details concerning the issue and limitations on the bids to be received, may be obtained from: Hutchinson, Shockey, Erley &Co., 200 N. Jefferson Street, Suite 100, Milwaukee, Wisconsin 53202, (414) 298-9898, financial advisor to the City, or the undersigned.
REBECCA K. NOLAND, CPA, Director of Finance-
